name: learn-gaitherstephens-com
description: FTCE study app. No dependencies: tests and deploy run with Node 22+ and npx wrangler.

scripts.deploy: node tools/predeploy-guard.mjs && npm test && npx wrangler@4 deploy --var COMMIT_SHA:$(node tools/predeploy-guard.mjs --sha) --message "$(node tools/predeploy-guard.mjs --sha) manual deploy"
